finocchio.definition: n aromatic bulbous stem base eaten cooked or raw in salads

finochio.definition:
n. An umbelliferous plant (Foeniculum dulce) having a
   somewhat tuberous stem; sweet fennel. The blanched stems are used in
   France and Italy as a culinary vegetable.

finos.definition: n. pl. Second best wool from Merino sheep.
finos.translation: n. fino（西班牙的干或甜雪利酒 ）的变形
